brief:
International organizations cautioned that Palestinian children in the Gaza Strip confront mounting risks of death and disease as winter approaches, the Palestine News Network reported. Severe shortages of food, medicine, and adequate shelter compound the threat, alongside continued Israeli restrictions on humanitarian assistance entering the territory.

Children in Gaza already face malnutrition and preventable illness in the besieged enclave as conditions worsen ahead of the colder months.
